summary: Tianci International filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiaries RQS United Group Limited and Roshing International Co., Limited entered an Enterprise AI Intelligent Integration Platform Service Agreement dated October 12, 2026 with Linknex Limited, a Hong Kong company. Consideration is $146,700 cash plus 180,000 restricted common shares issuable within twenty business days after Nasdaq listing of the shares. The parties intend a subsequent Statement of Work covering scope, milestones and acceptance criteria, with modular delivery and personnel training. This is an ordinary vendor services contract and unregistered equity issuance, not a control or ownership event; watch dilution and Nasdaq listing timing.
